chunks: He who warns you is one of the warners of old.

key_terms.نَذِيرٌ: A warner or herald of impending news

ai.seo_question: Who is identified as a warner in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of divine guidance by linking Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to the 'earlier warners,' affirming that his mission is the culmination of the same prophetic tradition. It highlights the universality of the warning message, reinforcing the belief that the Prophet serves as the final and most comprehensive bearer of divine admonition to all of humanity.
